rows:
Reduction of Specific oil consumption (HFO) in Calciners by application of HFO additives with
reduction of 1.8% from existing specific oil consumption.

GL Header of BAT-A, B & D has been modified (more loops have been removed) in evaporators for
increase of Steam Economy from 2.9 to 3.05.

Replacement of existing low capacity aluminate liquor pump-128 in security filtration. Existing 800
Cu.M/Hr pump is replaced with 1,200 Cu.M/Hr pump.

Installation of 100 nos. of 190W LED floodlight fittings in place of 400W conventional flood lights in
switchyards.
Installation of 200 nos. of 100W led highbay lights in place of 250W high bay fittings inside plant.
Installation of 3,000 nos. of 18W led tube lights in place of 40W tube light in offices.
Installation of 5,000 nos. of 40W led well glass fittings in place of 70W HPSV fittings inside plant.
